description: I transferred 25,000 naira from GTBank to my friend's OPay account with Session ID 100004241030123456789012345678 but he has not received it.
They debit me 50k from Access Bank since morning for transfer to Zenith, money no enter recipient account.
I bought 5000 MTN data on my GTBank mobile banking app. The bank debited me but my MTN line has not been credited with any data.
Someone stole my phone in traffic and they are emptying my account right now on GTBank! Help me lock it!
I paid an Instagram boutique 45,000 naira for 2 dresses on October 15. The delivery date was October 20. She has refused to deliver and blocked me on WhatsApp.
I bought a laptop charger for 32,000 naira on a website using my card via Paystack checkout. The merchant website is down and no charger was shipped.
I lost 2 million naira in a Telegram crypto trading bot that promised 50% weekly return.
Someone gave me a fake landlord agreement in Surulere.
I transferred 120k from Access Bank to Zenith Bank over 20 days ago. I reported it to Access (Ticket ACC-948201) but they haven't refunded me.
I recharged 3,000 Airtel airtime on my SIM, debited from FirstBank, no airtime. I called Airtel (Ticket AIR-849201) 8 days ago and no response.
I sent 15,000 naira with Kuda to PalmPay yesterday around 2pm. Kuda debited my balance but my brother has not seen the alert.
Moniepoint transfer of 80,000 naira to UBA failed. Debit alert arrived but beneficiary account is empty.
Transfer from FirstBank to GTBank 10000 naira since 3 days ago. FirstBank ticket number is FB-10293.

I purchased 10,000 MTN data on OPay app, OPay says successful but *312# shows 0MB and no data was received.
Recharged 1500 Glo airtime via Access Bank mobile banking. The bank deducted my account but my phone balance never increased.
I buy 2000 airtime 9mobile directly from my phone with recharge code. Network say pin already used.

They debited my FirstBank 2,500 for Airtel airtime. Still pending for 48 hours without credit.
Armed robbers snatched my bag containing my phone in Ikeja. They just transferred 150,000 from my UBA account! Block my account now!
I woke up and saw three unauthorized debits of 50,000 naira each from Access Bank that I never authorized.
Someone called posing as Zenith bank customer care and tricked me into sharing my OTP. 300k was debited immediately!
My SIM card stopped working and before I knew it, fraudsters used it to withdraw 450,000 naira from my GTBank app.
Unauthorized POS withdrawal on my debit card of 65,000 naira while the card was inside my wallet.

I paid a furniture maker 150,000 naira on WhatsApp to deliver a dining table within two weeks. 1 month has passed and he is giving endless excuses.
I bought running shoes for 28,000 naira on an e-commerce website using Flutterwave card checkout. Shoes were never delivered and store email bounces.
I paid a vendor 60,000 naira on TikTok for sneakers. She sent fake tracking number and deleted her TikTok profile.
Paid 95,000 naira online checkout via Paystack for perfume gift box. Merchant cancelled the order without refunding my debit card.
I invested 500,000 naira in an online forex academy that promised 40% monthly returns.
A travel agent took 1.2 million naira to process a Canadian study visa and gave me fake documents.
My sports betting account was suspended with 50,000 naira winnings.
Someone broke my car side mirror in traffic and drove away.
I need help with my transaction issue.
They debit me money.
